attributes.action:
Stop the sale of fireworks to the public.
How many human lives are too many?
attributes.additional_details:
Ive been campaigning for nearly 5 years since mums death.
Firework are enjoyed by many.
They can be enjoyed at organised, pre announced displays.
Giving the public prior notice of planned displays, gives vulnerable people and animals the chance to prepare.
Random fireworks being set of at all hours causes stress to people  animals and communities.
organised proffesional events allow communities to come together.
Public sales cause stress division and to me most importantly killed my mum.
attributes.background:
Mum Josephine, died as a result of a firework being put through her letterbox.
As did Robert price in the same way.
More often fireworks are being abused in this way.
Ive spoken to government, they are not listening.
How many lives does it take?
How many communities and animals have to suffer?

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
